passages.text: The man then brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary that faced east, but it was shut.
passages.sermon:
A man led me.
He brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary.
This gate faced east.
The gate was shut.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣שֶׁב אֹתִ֗י דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֤עַר הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ הַֽחִיצ֔וֹן הַפֹּנֶ֖ה קָדִ֑ים וְה֖וּא סָגֽוּר׃

passages.text: And the LORD said to me, “This gate is to remain shut. It shall not be opened, and no man shall enter through it, because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through it. Therefore it will remain shut.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He said, “This gate will stay shut.
No one will open it.
No person will enter through it.
The LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through this gate.
Because of this, the gate will remain shut.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י יְהוָ֗ה הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַזֶּה֩ סָג֨וּר יִהְיֶ֜ה לֹ֣א יִפָּתֵ֗חַ וְאִישׁ֙ לֹא־ יָ֣בֹא ב֔וֹ כִּ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣א ב֑וֹ וְהָיָ֖ה סָגֽוּר׃

passages.text: Only the prince himself may sit inside the gateway to eat in the presence of the LORD. He must enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way.”
passages.sermon:
The prince is the leader of the people.
Only the prince may sit inside the gateway.
He may eat bread in the presence of the LORD.
He must enter through the portico of the gateway.
He must go out the same way he entered.
passages.original: אֶֽת־ הַנָּשִׂ֗יא נָ֥שִׂיא ה֛וּא יֵֽשֶׁב־ בּ֥וֹ לֶאֱכָול־ לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִדֶּ֨רֶךְ אֻלָ֤ם הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ יָב֔וֹא וּמִדַּרְכּ֖וֹ יֵצֵֽא׃

passages.text: Then the man brought me to the front of the temple by way of the north gate. I looked and saw the glory of the LORD filling His temple, and I fell facedown.
passages.sermon:
A man led me.
He took me by the north gate.
He brought me to the front of the temple.
I looked.
I saw the glory of the LORD.
The glory of the LORD filled the temple.
I fell facedown.
passages.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֜נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ־ שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפוֹן֮ אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַבַּיִת֒ וָאֵ֕רֶא וְהִנֵּ֛ה מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל־ פָּנָֽי׃

passages.text: The LORD said to me: “Son of man, pay attention; look carefully with your eyes and listen closely with your ears to everything I tell you concerning all the statutes and laws of the house of the LORD. Take careful note of the entrance to the temple, along with all the exits of the sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He called me "son of man."
He told me to pay attention.
He told me to look carefully with my eyes.
He told me to listen closely with my ears.
He said I must listen to everything He tells me.
He said I must learn all the statutes and laws of the house of the LORD.
He told me to take careful note of the entrance to the temple.
He told me to take careful note of all the exits of the sanctuary.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י יְהֹוָ֗ה בֶּן־ אָדָ֡ם שִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֩ וּרְאֵ֨ה בְעֵינֶ֜יךָ וּבְאָזְנֶ֣יךָ שְּׁמָ֗ע אֵ֣ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אֹתָ֔ךְ לְכָל־ חֻקּ֥וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וּלְכָל־ תּוֹרֹתוֹ וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ לִבְּךָ֙ לִמְב֣וֹא הַבַּ֔יִת בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹצָאֵ֥י הַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Tell the rebellious house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I have had enough of all your abominations, O house of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The house of Israel is rebellious.
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
The Lord GOD says this.
I have had enough of all your abominations, house of Israel.
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֶל־ מֶ֙רִי֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה רַב־ לָכֶ֛ם מִֽכָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in both heart and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My temple when you offered My food—the fat and the blood; you broke My covenant.
passages.sermon:
The house of Israel committed many abominations.
You brought foreigners into My sanctuary.
These foreigners were uncircumcised in heart.
They were also uncircumcised in flesh.
You allowed them to be in My holy place.
You defiled My temple.
You did this when you offered My food.
You offered the fat and the blood.
You broke My covenant.
You did all these things along with your other abominations.
passages.original: בַּהֲבִיאֲכֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־ נֵכָ֗ר עַרְלֵי־ לֵב֙ וְעַרְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֔ר לִהְי֥וֹת בְּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י לְחַלְּל֣וֹ אֶת־ בֵּיתִ֑י בְּהַקְרִֽיבְכֶ֤ם אֶת־ לַחְמִי֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָדָ֔ם וַיָּפֵ֙רוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֔י אֶ֖ל כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And you have not kept charge of My holy things, but have appointed others to keep charge of My sanctuary for you.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
You did not guard My holy things.
You did not keep charge of what is sacred to Me.
You chose other people to guard My sanctuary instead of doing it yourselves.
passages.original: וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת קָדָשָׁ֑י וַתְּשִׂימ֗וּן לְשֹׁמְרֵ֧י מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֛י בְּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh may enter My sanctuary—not even a foreigner who lives among the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He gives a command.
No foreigner may enter His sanctuary.
This foreigner is uncircumcised in heart and flesh.
This rule applies to every foreigner.
It includes foreigners who live among the Israelites.
No such person may enter God's sanctuary.
passages.original: כֹּה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ כָּל־ בֶּן־ נֵכָ֗ר עֶ֤רֶל לֵב֙ וְעֶ֣רֶל בָּשָׂ֔ר לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֑י לְכָל־ בֶּן־ נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֕ר בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Surely the Levites who wandered away from Me when Israel went astray, and who wandered away from Me after their idols, will bear the consequences of their iniquity.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a group from the people of Israel.
The Levites wandered away from God.
They did this when Israel went astray.
They followed idols instead of God.
They turned away from God after these idols.
The Levites will bear the consequences of their sin.
They will be responsible for their iniquity.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָֽחֲקוּ֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י בִּתְע֤וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּע֣וּ מֵֽעָלַ֔י אַחֲרֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽם׃

passages.text: Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, having charge of the gates of the temple and ministering there. They shall slaughter the burnt offerings and other sacrifices for the people and stand before them to minister to them.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a group of Israelites.
The Levites turned away from God in the past.
God says the Levites will serve as ministers in His sanctuary.
The Levites will have charge of the gates of the temple.
The Levites will minister in the temple.
The Levites will slaughter the burnt offerings for the people.
The Levites will slaughter other sacrifices for the people.
The Levites will stand before the people.
The Levites will minister to the people.
passages.original: וְהָי֤וּ בְמִקְדָּשִׁי֙ מְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים פְּקֻדּוֹת֙ אֶל־ שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הַבַּ֔יִת וּֽמְשָׁרְתִ֖ים אֶת־ הַבָּ֑יִת הֵ֠מָּה יִשְׁחֲט֨וּ אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֤ה וְאֶת־ הַזֶּ֙בַח֙ לָעָ֔ם וְהֵ֛מָּה יַעַמְד֥וּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְשָֽׁרְתָֽם׃

passages.text: Because they ministered before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I swore with an uplifted hand concerning them that they would bear the consequences of their iniquity, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Levites served before their idols.
They became a stumbling block to the house of Israel.
They led Israel into sin.
Because of this, I, the Lord GOD, raised My hand and swore an oath against them.
They will bear the consequences of their iniquity.
passages.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשָׁרְת֤וּ אוֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י גִלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עָוֺ֑ן עַל־ כֵּן֩ נָשָׂ֨אתִי יָדִ֜י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽם׃

passages.text: They must not approach Me to serve Me as priests or come near any of My holy things or the most holy things. They will bear the shame of the abominations they have committed.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about certain people who served idols and led Israel into sin.
God says these people must not come near Him to serve as priests.
They must not approach God to serve Him.
They must not come near any of God's holy things.
They must not come near the most holy things.
They will carry the shame for what they have done.
They will bear the disgrace of their abominations.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלַי֙ לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֔י וְלָגֶ֙שֶׁת֙ עַל־ כָּל־ קָ֣דָשַׁ֔י אֶל־ קָדְשֵׁ֖י הַקְּדָשִׁ֑ים וְנָֽשְׂאוּ֙ כְּלִמָּתָ֔ם וְתוֹעֲבוֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: Yet I will appoint them to keep charge of all the work for the temple and everything to be done in it.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about the Levites who sinned.
God says, "I will appoint them to serve in the temple."
They will watch over the temple.
They will do all the work in the temple.
They will take care of everything that must be done in the temple.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַבָּ֑יִת לְכֹל֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ וּלְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה בּֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: But the Levitical priests, who are descended from Zadok and who kept charge of My sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from Me, are to approach Me to minister before Me. They will stand before Me to offer Me fat and blood, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Levitical priests are descendants of Zadok.
These priests kept charge of God's sanctuary.
They remained faithful when the Israelites went astray from God.
God commands these priests to approach Him.
They will minister before God.
They will stand before God.
They will offer God fat and blood.
The Lord GOD declares this.
passages.original: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם בְּנֵ֣י צָד֗וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁמְר֜וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ בִּתְע֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י הֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֵלַ֖י לְשָֽׁרְתֵ֑נִי וְעָמְד֣וּ לְפָנַ֗י לְהַקְרִ֥יב לִי֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָדָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: They alone shall enter My sanctuary and draw near to My table to minister before Me. They will keep My charge.
passages.sermon:
The Levitical priests are descended from Zadok.
They kept charge of God's sanctuary when the Israelites went astray.
Only these priests may enter God's sanctuary.
Only they may come near God's table.
They will serve God there.
They will keep God's charge.
passages.original: הֵ֜מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֗י וְהֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֶל־ שֻׁלְחָנִ֖י לְשָׁרְתֵ֑נִי וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּֽי׃

passages.text: When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen garments; they must not wear anything made of wool when they minister at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.
passages.sermon:
The Levitical priests are descendants of Zadok.
They serve God in the temple.
When these priests enter the gates of the inner court, they must wear linen garments.
They must not wear wool.
They must not wear wool when they serve at the gates of the inner court.
They must not wear wool inside the temple.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּבוֹאָם֙ אֶֽל־ שַׁעֲרֵי֙ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔ית בִּגְדֵ֥י פִשְׁתִּ֖ים יִלְבָּ֑שׁוּ וְלֹֽא־ יַעֲלֶ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ צֶ֔מֶר בְּשָֽׁרְתָ֗ם בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֛י הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖ית וָבָֽיְתָה׃

passages.text: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.
passages.sermon: The priests must wear linen turbans on their heads.\r\nThe priests must wear linen undergarments around their waists.\r\nThe priests must not wear anything that causes them to sweat.
passages.original: פַּאֲרֵ֤י פִשְׁתִּים֙ יִהְי֣וּ עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֔ם וּמִכְנְסֵ֣י פִשְׁתִּ֔ים יִהְי֖וּ עַל־ מָתְנֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א יַחְגְּר֖וּ בַּיָּֽזַע׃

passages.text: When they go out to the outer court, to the people, they are to take off the garments in which they have ministered, leave them in the holy chambers, and dress in other clothes so that they do not transmit holiness to the people with their garments.
passages.sermon:
The priests serve God in the temple.
The priests wear special garments when they minister inside.
When the priests go out to the outer court, they leave the inner area.
The priests go out to the people in the outer court.
The priests must take off the garments they used for service.
They must leave these garments in the holy chambers.
The priests must put on other clothes before meeting the people.
The priests must not transmit holiness to the people through their garments.
passages.original: וּ֠בְצֵאתָם אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֨ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֜ה אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִיצוֹנָה֮ אֶל־ הָעָם֒ יִפְשְׁט֣וּ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֙מָּה֙ מְשָׁרְתִ֣ם בָּ֔ם וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ אוֹתָ֖ם בְּלִֽשְׁכֹ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְלָֽבְשׁוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְלֹֽא־ יְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם בְּבִגְדֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but must carefully trim their hair.
passages.sermon: The priests must not shave their heads.\r\nThe priests must not let their hair grow long.\r\nThe priests must carefully trim their hair.
passages.original: וְרֹאשָׁם֙ לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֔חוּ וּפֶ֖רַע לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑חוּ כָּס֥וֹם יִכְסְמ֖וּ אֶת־ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: No priest may drink wine before he enters the inner court.
passages.sermon:
A priest serves God in the temple.
A priest must not drink wine.
A priest must not drink wine before entering the inner court.
A priest must be sober when he enters the inner court.
passages.original: וְיַ֥יִן לֹֽא־ יִשְׁתּ֖וּ כָּל־ כֹּהֵ֑ן בְּבוֹאָ֖ם אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃

passages.text: And they shall not marry a widow or a divorced woman, but must marry a virgin of the descendants of the house of Israel, or a widow of a priest.
passages.sermon:
The priests must not marry a widow.
The priests must not marry a divorced woman.
The priests must marry only a virgin.
The virgin must be from the descendants of the house of Israel.
The priests may also marry a widow if she was married to a priest.
passages.original: וְאַלְמָנָה֙ וּגְרוּשָׁ֔ה לֹֽא־ יִקְח֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם לְנָשִׁ֑ים כִּ֣י אִם־ בְּתוּלֹ֗ת מִזֶּ֙רַע֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהָֽאַלְמָנָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה אַלְמָנָ֔ה מִכֹּהֵ֖ן יִקָּֽחוּ׃

passages.text: They are to teach My people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to discern between the clean and the unclean.
passages.sermon: The priests must teach God’s people.\r\nThey must show the people the difference between what is holy and what is common.\r\nThey must also show the people how to tell what is clean and what is unclean.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ עַמִּ֣י יוֹר֔וּ בֵּ֥ין קֹ֖דֶשׁ לְחֹ֑ל וּבֵין־ טָמֵ֥א לְטָה֖וֹר יוֹדִעֻֽם׃

passages.text: In any dispute, they shall officiate as judges and judge according to My ordinances. They must keep My laws and statutes regarding all My appointed feasts, and they must keep My Sabbaths holy.
passages.sermon:
The priests must act as judges in any dispute.
They must judge according to God's ordinances.
They must keep God's laws.
They must keep God's statutes.
They must observe all of God's appointed feasts.
They must keep God's Sabbaths holy.
passages.original: וְעַל־ רִ֗יב הֵ֚מָּה יַעַמְד֣וּ לִשְׁפֹּט בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י וְשָׁפְטֻהוּ וְאֶת־ תּוֹרֹתַ֤י וְאֶת־ חֻקֹּתַי֙ בְּכָל־ מוֹעֲדַ֣י יִשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י יְקַדֵּֽשׁוּ׃

passages.text: A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person. However, for a father, a mother, a son, a daughter, a brother, or an unmarried sister, he may do so, and after he is cleansed, he must count off seven days for himself.
passages.sermon:
A priest must not go near a dead person.
If he does, he will become unclean.
He may go near a dead person only for close family.
He may do this for his father.
He may do this for his mother.
He may do this for his son.
He may do this for his daughter.
He may do this for his brother.
He may do this for his sister if she was not married.
After he becomes clean again, he must count seven days for himself.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ מֵ֣ת אָדָ֔ם לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא לְטָמְאָ֑ה כִּ֣י אִם־ לְאָ֡ב וּ֠לְאֵם וּלְבֵ֨ן וּלְבַ֜ת לְאָ֗ח וּלְאָח֛וֹת אֲשֶֽׁר־ לֹא־ הָיְתָ֥ה לְאִ֖ישׁ יִטַּמָּֽאוּ׃ וְאַחֲרֵ֖י טָֽהֳרָת֑וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים יִסְפְּרוּ־ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And on the day he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he must present his sin offering, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
A priest serves God in the sanctuary.
He enters the inner court to minister.
On the day he enters, he must bring his sin offering.
The Lord GOD commands this.
passages.original: וּבְיוֹם֩ בֹּא֨וֹ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֤ר הַפְּנִימִית֙ לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ יַקְרִ֖יב חַטָּאת֑וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: In regard to their inheritance, I am their inheritance. You are to give them no possession in Israel, for I am their possession.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about the priests of Israel.
God says, "I am their inheritance."
The priests do not receive land in Israel.
You must not give the priests any land as a possession.
God says, "I am their possession."
passages.original: וְהָיְתָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נַֽחֲלָתָ֑ם וַאֲחֻזָּ֗ה לֹֽא־ תִתְּנ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲנִ֖י אֲחֻזָּתָֽם׃

passages.text: They shall eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings. Everything in Israel devoted to the LORD will belong to them.
passages.sermon:
The priests serve God in the sanctuary.
The priests eat the grain offerings.
The priests eat the sin offerings.
The priests eat the guilt offerings.
Everything in Israel that people devote to the LORD belongs to the priests.
passages.original: הַמִּנְחָה֙ וְהַחַטָּ֣את וְהָאָשָׁ֔ם הֵ֖מָּה יֹֽאכְל֑וּם וְכָל־ חֵ֥רֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָהֶ֥ם יִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: The best of all the firstfruits and of every contribution from all your offerings will belong to the priests. You are to give your first batch of dough to the priest, so that a blessing may rest upon your homes.
passages.sermon:
God gave the priests a special role in Israel.
The priests receive the best of all the firstfruits.
The priests also receive every contribution from all your offerings.
You must give your first batch of dough to the priest.
This act brings a blessing to your home.
passages.original: וְרֵאשִׁית֩ כָּל־ בִּכּ֨וּרֵי כֹ֜ל וְכָל־ תְּר֣וּמַת כֹּ֗ל מִכֹּל֙ תְּרוּמ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְרֵאשִׁ֤ית עֲרִסֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ תִּתְּנ֣וּ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן לְהָנִ֥יחַ בְּרָכָ֖ה אֶל־ בֵּיתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: The priests may not eat any bird or animal found dead or torn by wild beasts.
passages.sermon:
The priests serve God in Israel.
The priests must not eat any animal found dead.
The priests must not eat any animal torn by wild beasts.
The priests must not eat any bird found dead.
The priests must not eat any bird torn by wild beasts.
passages.original: כָּל־ נְבֵלָה֙ וּטְרֵפָ֔ה מִן־ הָע֖וֹף וּמִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה לֹ֥א יֹאכְל֖וּ הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃פ
